target: 587 “Decēptus”

source: 587 “Deceived”
target: 587 “Decēptus”

source: Upon hearing the young man’s words, Bard felt his blood rush to his head.
target: Auditis verbis iuvenis, Bardus sensit sanguinem suum celeriter in caput ascendere.

source: Crafting a seemingly valid rule over a millennium to deceive others?
target: Constituens praeceptum quod validum videtur per mille annos ad alios decipiendos?

source: What kind of lame antique Swindler is this?
target: Qualis hic claudicans antiquus impostor est?

source: Bard blurted out, “The patterns on the altar and the surrounding arrangements are also fake?”
target: Bard subito exclamavit: “Figurae in altare et dispositiones circumiectae quoque fictae sunt?”

source: The young man in the dark-blue deputy host robe chuckled.
target: Iuvenis, in veste caerulea obscura, quam ut vicarius hospitis gerebat, risit.

source: “If it wasn’t real, would you have been deceived?”
target: “Si non verum esset, decipiererisne?”

source: “Furthermore, I occasionally venture out.
target: Praeterea, interdum exeo.”

source: “When I do, it grants Steal powers on my behalf.”
target: Cum id facio, mihi tribuit potestates furtivas.

source: “Of course, with the spirituality produced by the surrounding worshippers, it can indeed only bestow once a year.”
target: Certe, cum spiritualitas ab cultoribus circumstantibus producta sit, id vere semel in anno tribui potest.

source: As the young man spoke, the smile on his face widened.
target: Dum iuvenis loquebatur, risus in facie eius amplius patebat.

source: Bard’s forehead throbbed as he listened, feeling like he had been mocked.
target: Frons Bardi pulsabat dum auscultabat, quasi derisus esset.

source: According to the other party’s claim that the Steal powers could be bestowed at will, the Ring of the Sea Queen should have been complete and equipped with all its functions.
target: Secundum assertionem alterius partis, quod potestates furtivas volenter tribui poterant, Annulus Reginae Maris plenus esse debuisset et omnibus functionibus instructus.

source: So, why did the success of the sea prayer ritual experience such a significant delay?
target: Ergo, cur successus ritus maris precationis tam magnam moram passus est?

source: Unable to comprehend the situation, Bard turned around and sprinted towards the exit.
target: Non rem intellegens, Bard se vertit et ad exitum cucurrit.

source: It wasn’t that he hadn’t considered begging for mercy and surrendering on the spot, but these things could be done later.
target: Non enim statim misericordiam petendi atque tradendi occasionem cepit, sed haec postea perfici posse arbitrabatur.

source: For now, he wanted to take a gamble, betting that the other party’s claim of occasionally venturing out was a lie.
target: Nunc autem voluit aleam iactare, confitens affirmationem alterius partis de interdum exeundi mendaciam esse.

source: In essence, he believed he was trapped in the altar, unable to venture anywhere and influence the people around him.
target: In summa putabat se in altare inclusum esse, neque alibi exeundi nec homines circa se commovendi posse.

source: If he allowed himself to be intimidated and didn’t dare to escape, he would fall into the other party’s trap, cheated of his freedom and future.
target: Si se sineret intimidari et effugere non audiret, in insidias alterius partis incidere debebat, libertate sua et futuro fraudatus.

source: Thud! Thud! Thud! Bard reached the staircase in a few steps and ran up.
target: Thud! Thud! Thud! Bardus in paucis gradibus scalae accessit et ascendit currente.

source: The more he ran, the happier he became. The monocle-wearing young man didn’t stop him.
target: Quo magis cucurrit, eo laetior fiebat. Iuvenis, qui monoculum gerebat, eum non cohibebat.

source: I made the right bet!
target: Rectam aleam cepi!

source: He’s the core of that altar. There’s no way to leave!
target: Ipse est nucleus altaris; nulla via ad egressum est!

source: Thud! Thud! Thud! Bard witnessed the scene on the first floor illuminated by sunlight.
target: Thud! Thud! Thud! Bard scaenam in primo tabulato, sole illustratam, conspexit.

source: Amidst his ecstasy, his thoughts suddenly shattered.
target: Inter extatiam suam, cogitationes eius subito dissolutae sunt.

source: He felt the darkness around him being pierced by the light, shattering into pieces.
target: Sensit tenebras circa se, lumine transmittendo, in fragmenta dissolutas.

source: Bard bolted upright, alarmed to find himself lying in the servant’s room at the Governor of the Sea’s residence. He hadn’t left.
target: Bard subito surrexit, perterrita cum se in conclavi servorum in domicilio Gubernatoris Maris iacere inveniret. Non discesserat.

source: He surveyed his surroundings and heard cheers and crackers from outside.
target: Circumspiciebat et ex foris plausus ac crepitus sonorum festorum audivit.

source: I just had a dream?
target: Modo somnium habui?

source: Did it stem from a spirituality warning, helping me discover a problem with the plan?
target: Num ex monitione spirituali orta est, quae me ad consilii problema detegendum adiuvit?

source: As Bard pondered these thoughts, he immediately dismissed the corresponding judgment.
target: Dum Bard has cogitationes considerabat, statim iudicium adaequatum deiecit.

source: No, how could I have fallen asleep during the sea prayer ritual?
target: Minime, quomodo in ritu maris precationis obdormiri potuerim?

source: Did I start dreaming after hearing soft footsteps in my room?
target: Num somniare coepi postquam levia vestigia in cubiculo meo audivi?

source: Bard rolled to his feet, slung his backpack over his shoulders, and tentatively pushed open the door, entering the corridor.
target: Bard ad pedes evasit, sacculum super umeros suspensus et timide ianuam aperiens in corridorium ingreditus est.

source: No longer smug with the plan that required minimal risks or combat, Bard realized he couldn’t share in the distribution of items.
target: Non iam superbus de consilio, quod minimis periculis vel certamine necessarium erat, Bard intellexit se in distributione rerum participare non posse.

source: He couldn’t teleport away directly, nor could he return to his original appearance or disguise himself as someone else.
target: Nec directe se teleportare poterat, nec ad formam primariam redire aut se alio modo simulare.

source: Upon reaching the corridor, Bard noticed the Little Devils leaving the shadows and performing a strange celebratory dance.
target: Ad corridorium perveniens, Bard animadvertit Parvos Diabolos ex umbris egredientes et saltationem celebrativam insolitam agere.

source: He hadn’t “communicated” with these sea spawn and knew their intelligence was roughly equivalent to that of ordinary dogs.
target: Non cum his marinis progenie “communicaverat” et scivit eorum intelligentiam circa aequipollentiam canum vulgarium esse.

source: They could be tamed and controlled, but direct communication was beyond them.
target: Domari et regiri poterant, sed directa conversatio eis extra erat.

source: However, the amazing thing was that Little Devils had the ability to record and recreate human words, even if they weren’t sure of their meanings.
target: Verumtamen mirum erat quod Diaboli Parvi facultatem habebant verbis humanis recordandis et recreandis, etiamsi significationem earum ignorabant.

source: Moreover, they could receive signals from their collaborators within a 100-meter radius.
target: Praeterea, signa a cooperantibus suis intra centum metra radium accipere poterant.

source: The Little Devils ignored Bard as well.
target: Diaboli Parvi etiam Bardum neglexerunt.

source: The sea prayer ritual had succeeded.
target: Ritus maris precationis prosperaverat.

source: According to their prior agreement, the fake Governor of the Sea could leave on his own.
target: Secundum priorem conventionem, fictus Gubernator Maris solus exire poterat.

source: Bard left the Governor of the Sea’s residence and realized that the guards at the entrance weren’t kneeling to thank the boon like before.
target: Bard domicilium Gubernatoris Maris reliquit et animadvertit custodes ad ingressum non genu flectere ut beneficium antea gratias agerent.

source: The villagers of Milo Village at the docks were the same.
target: Incolae Vicus Milo apud portum idem erant.

source: Apart from a few who sincerely shouted that the sea prayer ritual had succeeded, the rest merely echoed what was happening and expressed their joy, with many preferring to release crackers.
target: Praeter paucos, qui sincere clamaverunt ritum maris precationis prospere fuisse, ceteri solum id quod agebatur resonare fecerunt et gaudium suum efferebant, plurimi autem praevaleant sonos bomborum emittens.

source: Indeed, it was a dream.
target: Revera, somnium erat.

source: The villagers’ reactions in the dream were too exaggerated…
target: Responsiones incolarum in somnio nimis amplificatae erant…

source: I should know that based on past experiences with sea prayer rituals, only the committee members of the Fisheries Guild and a few people with strong sea bloodlines can sense the arrival of the sea’s boon.
target: Ex praeteritis experientiis ritus maris precationis, scire debui quod solum membra commissionis Gildae Piscatoriae ac pauci eorum cum sanguine marino robusto adventum beneficii maris sentit.

source: Others with sea bloodlines wouldn’t have a tangible sense.
target: Alteri cum sanguine marino sensum tangibilem non habebunt.

source: They’d slowly realize they’ve become stronger, or the changes are too weak to detect.
target: Paulatim intellexerent se fortiores factos esse, aut mutationes nimis leves ad agnoscendum.

source: Otherwise, the failure of the sea prayer ritual last year wouldn’t have escaped the notice of Port Santa’s citizens and would have only circulated within the core circle.
target: Alioquin defectus ritus maris precationis anni pristini non evanuisset a conspectu civium Portus Sanctae et solum intra circulum nucleare diffusus fuisset.

source: Bard used the environment to quickly confirm the essence of his previous encounter.
target: Bard ambitum ad celeriter confirmandam essentiam pristini congressus sui usus est.

source: He didn’t dare relax, nor did he “again” head to the docks to admire the villagers being fooled. Instead, he turned to the road leading to Port Santa’s city district.
target: Non ausus est quiescere, nec iterum ad portum accedere ut incolas decipientes admiraret; pro eo, ad viam quae ad districtum urbis Portus Sanctae ducit se vertit.

source: Just as he stepped out of the ancient village, Bard spotted a figure ahead.
target: Ita ut e vico antiquo exiretur, Bard figuram in praeviso conspexit.

source: The man stood over 2.4 meters tall, clad in a simple linen robe and a hood, holding a thick staff.
target: Vir plus quam 2.4 metris stans, simplici lintea tunica et pallio indutus, baculo crasso tenebat.

source: “Gandalf…” Bard’s heart tightened as he shouted.
target: “Gandalf…” Cordis Bardi contraxit, cum clamavit.

source: With the dream just now, he thought he had been exposed, so he didn’t pull off any act.
target: Ex somnio nuper, putavit se detectum esse, ergo nihil simulavit.

source: Gandalf, the president of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society, was taken aback and let out a deep chuckle.
target: Gandalf, praeses Societatis de Simiis Crispatis, obstupuit et profundum risum edidit.

source: “You’re really fake.”
target: “Vere falso es.”

source: H-he’s not sure of my identity? Bard was taken aback, wishing he could slap himself.
target: “Nonne certus est de identitate mea?” Bard obstupuit, sperans se ipsum verberari posse.

source: Inside the underwater spaceship, in a metallic room reminiscent of a beehive.
target: Intra navem subaquaticam spatialis, in conclavi metallico, quod ad alvearium similitudinem habet.

source: Having failed to capture Mad Lady twice in a row, Mr. K’s body underwent a sudden transformation, expanding to nearly three meters in height.
target: Bis continuatum Mad Lady capere defessus, corpus Domini K subito mutatum est, ad paene tres metra altitudinis expandens.

source: Fortunately, he wasn’t adorned in actual clothes. The blood-colored cloak draped over him had morphed from his flesh and blood. Otherwise, even the loose robe would have succumbed to the drastic change.
target: Fortunate, non veris vestimentis indutus erat. Pallium sanguine tinctum, super eum drapatum, ex carne et sanguine eius ortum est. Aliter, etiam laxa tunica mutationi drasticae succumbisset.

source: Concurrently, Mr. K’s skin darkened, assuming the appearance of thick and formidable armor. Crooked goat horns adorned with sinister patterns sprouted from his head, and a pair of bat-like wings, encircled in crimson and blue flames, emerged from his back.
target: Simul, cutis Domini K obscurata est, vestigia armorum spissorum et formidabilium assumens. Cornua caprina angusta, insignibus sinistris ornata, ex capite eius orta sunt, et par alarum vespertilionum, in flammas rubras et caeruleas circumdatus, ex dorso eius eminuit.

source: A pungent smell of sulfur hung in the air.
target: Odor sulphuris acer in aere pendebat.

source: Being a Sequence 5 Shepherd of the Secrets Suppliant pathway, Mr. K possessed the core ability of Grazing.
target: Ut Pastor Sequens V in via Secretorum Supplicantium, Dominus K facultatem centralem pascendi habebat.

source: This allowed him to fuse other people’s souls with Beyonder characteristics or boon powers and utilize them uniquely.
target: Hoc ei permittebat animas aliorum cum proprietatibus Beyonder seu potentia beneficii coniungere atque singillatim uti.

source: It was akin to grazing lambs for a deity.
target: Hoc simile erat pascere agnos pro deo.

source: Each Shepherd could graze up to seven souls, controlling only one at a time.
target: Quisque Pastor ad septem animas pascere poterat, uno tempore solum regens.

source: In this state, Shepherds could employ their Beyonder abilities and three abilities corresponding to the souls.
target: In hoc statu, Pastores facultates Beyonder atque tres facultates, quae animis respondent, adhibere poterant.

source: These were chosen during Grazing and remained fixed thereafter.
target: Hae in tempore pascendi delectae sunt et postea constabant.

source: The most formidable aspect of Shepherds was their ability to Graze demigod-level spirits, enabling them to contend with Saints for a limited duration.
target: Maxima pars pastorum erat facultas spiritus semideorum pascendi, quae eos ad certamen cum sanctis per tempus limitatum provocare licuit.

source: Presently, Mr. K was using a Grazed Devil. He had selected Devil Transformation, Sulphur Fireball, and Sword of Lava in the past.
target: Nunc, Domini K Diabolum pascit, et antea electum habuit: Transformationem Diaboli, Sphaeram Ignis Sulphurei, et Gladium Lavæ.

source: Mr. K deliberately chose to forgo Devil’s most distinctive Danger Premonition because he believed it to be effective only when commanding the Devil’s spirit.
target: Dominus K conscio elegit relinquere praenotitiam maximi periculi Diaboli, quod credebat eam solum efficacem esse cum Diaboli spiritu imperaret.

source: Under normal circumstances, he couldn’t activate Grazing continuously.
target: Sub condicionibus ordinariis, pascendo continue activare non poterat.

source: In any case, if grave danger loomed, a divine revelation would be provided by God.
target: Quocumque consitu, si gravis periculum immineret, revelatio divina ab Deo praebenda esset.

source: Failure to receive such guidance indicated wrongdoing, warranting divine punishment.
target: Defectus huius ductus accipere malum indicabat, quod poena divina postularetur.

source: As the expansive bat wings on Mr. K’s back unfolded, light-blue fireballs condensed, numbering almost twenty.
target: Dum alae vespertilionum in dorso Domini K evolutae sunt, globuli ignis caerulei lenis condensati sunt, fere viginti numerabantur.

source: They indiscriminately bombarded every corner of the metallic beehive, creating an all-encompassing barrage to counter Mad Lady’s elusive “flashes” throughout the space.
target: Omnem angulum alvearii metallici sine discrimine oppresserunt, efformantes universum impetum ad repellendas fulgurationes elusorias Mad Lady per spatium.

source: Rumble!
target: Rumble!

source: The explosion, a mix of fire and poison, wreaked havoc on the metallic hive, tearing apart the incubating Batings Black Insect, Little Devils, and other creatures.
target: Explosio, mixtura ignis et veneni, in alvearium metallicum vastitatem attulit, dilanians Batings Black Insect, Diaboli Parvi, et alias creaturas.

source: Mad Lady abruptly halted as the Sulfur Fireball condensed.
target: Mad Lady subito sistit, dum sphaera ignis sulphurei condensabatur.

source: Cloaked in a blood-colored dress, with grotesque flesh lumps on her face, an illusory, slowly flipping book materialized in her eyes. Faint recitations echoed around her.
target: Vestis sanguine tincta induta, cum scelerosis carnis nodis in facie, liber illusorius lente volvens in oculis eius apparuit; recitationes leves circa eam resonaverunt.

source: Drawing a dagger, she genuflected and drove it into the metal floor of the hive.
target: Pugio sumens, genu flectens in pavimentum metallicum alvearii immergit.

source: Dawn-like light ascended, forming an almost invisible wall around her.
target: Lumen aurorale ascendit, formans parietem paene invisibilem circa eam.

source: Rumble!
target: Rumble!

source: The shockwaves from the Sulfur Fireball’s explosion and the poisonous pale-blue fireball relentlessly struck the invisible barrier, causing it to sway, yet it stood resilient.
target: Undae ictuum ex explosione sphaerae ignis sulphurei et sphaerae ignis pallide caeruleae venenosae percutiebant parietem invisibilem, eam oscillare facientes, sed quidem firmiter stabat.

source: This was Protection of a Warrior Sequence 5.
target: Hoc erat Munimen Bellatoris Sequens V.

source: Record, the core ability of a Sequence 6 Scribe of the Apprentice pathway, allowed the “recording” of others’ abilities for use, each recording usable only once.
target: Recordum, facultas centralis Scriptoris Sequens VI in via Discipulorum, licebat aliorum facultates ad usum “recordari,” quarum unusquisque semel tantum adhiberi poterat.

source: Scribes could even record Beyonder powers with godhood effects, but the success rate was minimal.
target: Scriptoribus etiam potestates Beyonder cum effectibus deitatis recordari poterant, sed successus eorum minimus erat.

source: After the explosion’s aftershocks subsided, Mr. K, donned in a blood-colored cloak and resembling a colossal Devil, wielded a broadsword composed of crimson lava and pale-blue flames. He surged towards Mad Lady in two steps, slashing down.
target: Postquam remotae post explosionem tremores cessaverunt, Dominus K, indutus pallio sanguine tincto et ingenti diablo similis, gladium latum ex lava rubra ac flammis caeruleis pallidisque confectum portavit. Duobus passibus versus Mad Lady impetum fecit, caedens.

source: The nearly invisible wall around Mad Lady couldn’t withstand the onslaught and finally shattered. As the illusory book in her eyes flipped, a robust and sharp Sword of Dawn materialized in her hand.
target: Paries paene invisibilis circa Mad Lady impetum sustinere non potuit et denique confractus est. Dum liber illusorius in oculis eius volvens videbatur, in manu eius gladius Aurorae robustus ac acutus apparuit.

source: Excitedly, she swung her two-handed light sword.
target: Exsultans gladium levem duobus manibus tenens concussit.

source: Clang!
target: Clang!

source: Mr. K’s strike sent Mad Lady, lacking a Warrior’s physique and strength, flying.
target: Percussio Domini K Mad Lady volitare coegit, quae corporis et virium bellatoris caret.

source: Though Mr. K hadn’t anticipated her determination to engage in close combat despite her limitations, the battle’s tempo remained unaffected. He advanced, wielding the lava broadsword once again.
target: Quamquam Dominus K non antevidebat eius propositum in certamine prope aggrediendi, momentum belli constare remanebat. Progrediebatur, gladium lavæ latum iterum gerens.

source: Poof! The Mad Lady he struck suddenly thinned, transforming into a paper figurine consumed by sulfurous flames.
target: Poof! Mad Lady, a qua percussus est, subito tenuata, in figuram papyraceam in igne sulphureo consumpta convertit.

source: Paper Figurine Substitutes!
target: Substitutiones Figuræ Papyraceæ!

source: Mad Lady reappeared beside a demolished metal hive, her illusory book flipping once more.
target: Mad Lady iuxta alvearium metallicum destructum iterum apparuit, liber illusorius ejus iterum volvens.

source: She then stretched her arms, allowing a pure and magnificent blazing pillar of light to descend from the sky and strike Mr. K, who had attacked the paper effigy.
target: Deinde brachia protendit, permittebat columna pura et praeclara luminis ardentis de caelo descendere et Dominum K percussum, qui papyraceam effigiem aggressus erat, percutere.

source: Priest of Light’s Light of Holiness!
target: Sacerdos Lucis: Lux Sanctitatis!
